pressureSignals.explanation: The caller indicates that the issue needs immediate approval.
pressureSignals.quote: we noticed an issue with your subscription payment and need you to approve the corrected charge

raw.summary: The caller claims to be billing from Kettle and Co., requesting the user approve a corrected subscription charge of $18.00 USD to the saved recipient Kettle & Co. (billing@kettleandco.example) for the purpose of subscription correction.
